comfy_node_revision.note: Must equal ARG COMFYUI_COMMIT in docker/comfyui/Dockerfile and services.comfyui.build.args.COMFYUI_COMMIT in docker/docker-compose.yaml; tests/unit/test_comfyui_compose_contract.py enforces all three. vram.gpu: NVIDIA RTX A4000, 16376 MiB, host GPU0 (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0)
vram.staged_vram_mb_source: measured - ComfyUI 'Model <name> prepared for dynamic VRAM loading. <N>MB Staged' lines from `docker logs docker-comfyui-1` (image datapipeline-comfyui:0.1, 2026-09-18 activation run: 26 FLUX executions, 1 SDXL execution). Same boot logged 'Total VRAM 16102 MB' and 'Set vram state to: LOW_VRAM'.
vram.staged_vram_mb_meaning: Weight staging footprint per model as reported by ComfyUI. It is NOT peak process VRAM: under LOW_VRAM weights are streamed, and activations are not included.
vram.peak_process_vram_note: MEASURED: YES (2026-09-21, P2-4 quality UAT). 15.02 GB is the highest GPU0 total observed across both workflows over 20 generations; the FLUX workflow owns that maximum. Per-workflow figures are in workflows.<id>.peak_process_vram_gb_measured. Source and method in peak_process_vram_gb_source.
vram.peak_process_vram_gb_source: measured - P2-4 20-image quality UAT, 2026-09-21, prod docker-comfyui-1 on host GPU0 (RTX A4000, 16376 MiB, --lowvram). Method: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits` sampled once per second for the whole UAT; per job the maximum GPU0 value inside [gpu_started_at-2s, gpu_completed_at+2s] taken from genai_job_provenance. This is a whole-GPU figure and includes the ~0.7 GB idle baseline from other host processes. Jobs are serialized by the gpu0_comfy lease so run windows never overlap. Caveat: ComfyUI --lowvram keeps weights cached between executions, so a workflow's peak depends on which workflow ran before it - use min_gb as the isolated-footprint estimate and max_gb for capacity planning. Review sheet: docs/genai_rollout/comfyui-uat-20-review-sheet-2026-09-21.md
vram.preflight_threshold_note: COMFYUI_MIN_FREE_VRAM_GB, the GenAI adapter's admission threshold (docker/docker-compose.yaml default; prod overrides in docker/.env). RAISED 13 -> 14.5 on 2026-09-21 after the P2-4 UAT. Derivation: the gate is evaluated in _prepare_gpu AFTER the embedding service has unloaded PE-Core, so it does not guard against the embedding service - it guards against OTHER GPU0 tenants (angle-dav2-1 runs with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0). Measured on a 16376 MiB card with a 784 MiB baseline from those tenants: a warm FLUX run peaked at 15379 MiB total, i.e. 14.25 GB of its own footprint; a cold run needs about 13.0 GB (7 of 10 runs clustered at 13.78 GB total, 3 carried weight-cache residue at 15.36 GB). The old 13 GB therefore admitted jobs whenever free VRAM was 13.0-14.25 GB and a warm run then OOMed. 14.5 closes that window; today's post-unload free is 14.94 GB so normal operation still passes, with 0.44 GB of slack before the gate starts deferring. Rejection is the safe failure (AdapterDeferredError -> lease released -> retried next tick); admission followed by OOM wastes a GPU run and a lease cycle. If deferrals become frequent the fix is to flush the weight cache before each run (POST /free {unload_models, free_memory}) so the requirement becomes a deterministic ~13.0 GB - NOT to lower this threshold again.
vram.baseline_other_tenants_note: MEASURED 2026-09-21: 784 MiB held on host GPU0 by processes that are not ComfyUI and not the embedding service (three compute apps; angle-dav2-1 runs with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0). peak_process_vram_gb is a whole-GPU figure, so a workflow's OWN footprint is peak_process_vram_gb - baseline_other_tenants_gb, and that difference is what the admission threshold has to cover. Re-measure with: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid,used_memory --format=csv,noheader (GPU0 uuid from --query-gpu=index,uuid) while ComfyUI is idle and PE-Core is unloaded.

exec_seconds_measured.source: ComfyUI 'Prompt executed in N seconds', same UAT. Near-constant because node 5 ImageScaleToTotalPixels normalizes every input to 1 MP.

steps.note: Distilled Klein schedule; the adapter rejects any value other than 4.

unbound.mask_image: not accepted - no mask node in the graph
unbound.negative_prompt: not bindable - node 7 ConditioningZeroOut derives the negative branch from the positive one
unbound.denoise: not applicable - node 17 SamplerCustomAdvanced consumes the full sigma schedule

peak_process_vram_gb_measured.source: P2-4 UAT 2026-09-21; method in vram.peak_process_vram_gb_source. The two 12943 MiB samples followed FLUX executions, so they carry FLUX cache residue - 7.55 GB is the better isolated-footprint estimate.

exec_seconds_measured.source: ComfyUI 'Prompt executed in N seconds', same UAT. Scales with source resolution because this workflow has no resize node: 960x480 ~10.1s, 1108x828 ~14.8s, 1920x1080 ~29s.

mask_image.note: Binary 0/255 PNG, identical resolution to source_image; only the 255 region is edited.

notes.input_schema_source: Derived from each workflow JSON's own `bindings` map - the only parameters the gateway is allowed to substitute. tests/unit/test_comfyui_compose_contract.py asserts inputs == bindings, so the schema cannot drift from the graph.
notes.value_constraints_owner: Ranges and the FLUX steps==4 rule are enforced by docker/genai/adapters/comfy_local.py; this manifest records the wiring, not the validator.
